digest.component_or_area: LLM-Review production gate (code-review agent via Bedrock)
propositions: the production review-bot service must be pointed at Bedrock inference profiles for all per-pass model classes (frontier/standard/trivial) via environment variable class slots, without REBAR_LLM_MODEL and without cross-provider fallback

the review-bot container image must install the bedrock extra in its uv sync invocation so pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock is available and bedrock_model.py can construct the provider without raising LLMConfigError
a kill-switch recovery path via environment-variable reversion must be proven functional on the Anthropic path (with credential retained by design) before the Bedrock cutover is deployed

induced VOTER_ERROR on the pre-cutover Anthropic path must transition the rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm from OK to ALARM, and the Bedrock client-error alarm must exist in CloudWatch and show OK (not INSUFFICIENT_DATA) on real traffic before the flip is submitted

the production gate must produce real LLM-Review votes via Bedrock with per-call usage-log evidence showing every call on bedrock: inference profiles, zero direct-Anthropic calls, frontier→opus and standard→sonnet class resolution, and nonzero cache_read_tokens
all four observations of an IAM-denied-access drill must be recorded: VOTER_ERROR emitted, no approving vote cast, the alarm fired, and retry after restore succeeded
